protocol.continuation_solver: exact conflict-backjumping GCTS with the proposed radius-three patch fixed
protocol.cut: a fixed-placement obstruction clause extracted only after exact radius-four continuation exhaustion

eager_one_step_coverability_ablation.conclusion: The eager necessary-condition encoding did not supply a proposal at either tested copy bound. The lightweight proposal model plus exact lazy obstruction learning supplied twenty states in less aggregate solver time than either single eager run.

interpretation: Twenty clause-distinct radius-three proposals, including one with 43 surrounding copies, all fail exact radius-four continuation. Every failure is already exposed by an immediate dead target and yields a two-placement obstruction, so this experiment strengthens the negative finite-corona evidence but does not yet reach the deeper resolved-subtree regime seen for p9-42947. Because the radius-three proposal space is not exhausted, the result proves neither non-tiling nor aperiodicity.
